title: GTA 6 weather explained: storms, hurricanes, puddles
yt_title: Will hurricanes hit your GTA 6 game? 🌀 Weather explained
description: Will hurricanes hit your GTA 6 game? Rockstar confirmed tropical storms and hurricanes, plus persistent weather: areas that just got rain stay wet, with puddles that last (Dexerto, GamingBolt). GamesRadar reports storms rock boats, damage planes and send people running for shelter. A bug that froze the weather for long stretches was fixed in the November 23 patch. How often hurricanes hit hasn't been revealed. No spoilers. Has a hurricane hit your game yet? Comment below.

lines.text: Will hurricanes hit your GTA 6 game? Rockstar confirmed tropical storms, and even full hurricanes.
lines.headline: 1/4 · STORMS

lines.text: The weather also sticks around: after it rains, the streets stay wet, with puddles that last.
lines.headline: 2/4 · IT STAYS

lines.text: When a storm hits, it rocks boats, damages planes, and sends people running for shelter.
lines.headline: 3/4 · STORM EFFECTS

lines.text: One bug: the weather could get stuck for long stretches. The November 23rd patch fixed it, on PS5 and Xbox.
lines.headline: 4/4 · STUCK WEATHER

lines.text: How often do hurricanes hit? Rockstar hasn't said yet, so keep an eye on the sky.
lines.headline: UNKNOWN
